Your whole chart, read in full.

The Ascendant

The sign that stood on the eastern horizon at your first breath — the face you meet the world with, and the door through which the rest of the chart is entered.

The Seven Heavens

The old cosmology counts the seven classical spheres as seven heavens, each sealed with one of the Divine Names. Read against your chart, each heaven speaks through the sign it occupied at your birth.

Planetary Aspects

The conversations your planets were holding at the moment of your birth — and have continued ever since. The tightest angles speak loudest, and are given first.

Sign Positions of Planets

Each planet, read in the sign it occupied at your birth — the faculty itself, and the manner your nature gives it.

House Positions of Planets

The same planets, read by the rooms of life they occupy — where each faculty does its daily work.

House positions and the Ascendant require a birth time. The sign and aspect readings above still stand.
